text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a research article focused on developing and applying an ecological integrity index for landscape conservation in the northeastern United States. Although it includes an application involving 70-year projections of urban growth scenarios, the primary focus is ecological assessment and conservation planning rather than land use/land cover (LULC) prediction modeling. The LULC scenarios used are generated by a separate model (SPRAWL) and serve as inputs for impact assessment, not as the primary research question. The study area is regional (northeastern US), not national-scale (entire country). There is no explicit national-scale spatial implementation, and LULC prediction is not the central focus. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for national-scale LULC prediction studies and is excluded.)
